notes.title: Pusheep is out now!
notes.content:
Today (March 24th, 2022), I’m thrilled to announce that Pusheep is now available, with a 15% launch discount.
After nearly 18 months of development and hard work (wow that’s enough time to have two babies) the game is finally in a playable state. 
I say playable state since a game is never finished. I can think of the top of my mind of 10 additional features that I would like to implement for the game, but scope creep is a real thing, and I couldn’t wait anymore to share it with the world.
As a solo indie game developer, with a full-time job, and little to no experience publishing “real” commercial games, I am very proud and thrilled to push this game to the world, and I hope that you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.

(ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧
